title: The Zeeman K_bound
author: Dentatus Series 300
hypothesis: Field-weighted K_budget allocation (Zeeman splitting) produces directionally asymmetric recursion depth while preserving P_yz budget covariance: K_fwd[i] == K_mir[i XOR 4] for all octant pairs.
field_B_note: Arbitrary 3D vector with nonzero x-component to fully exercise Option B P_yz transform.
beta_Z_note: Softmax temperature for Zeeman energy level weighting.
K_child_conservation: sum_i K_child_i = K_budget * exp(-LAMBDA_DECAY) -- total budget decays by exp(-LAMBDA_DECAY) per level (guaranteed convergence). Individual child i gets w_i fraction of total.
K_child_uniform_limit: beta_Z -> 0: w_i -> 1/N, K_child_i -> K_budget/N * exp(-LAMBDA_DECAY). With K_budget_root=N*K_312: each child gets K_312 * exp(-LAMBDA_DECAY) = EXP-312.
P_yz_field_rule: B transforms as a polar vector under P_yz (x -> -x): B_mir = (-B_x, B_y, B_z)
P_yz_covariance_proof: centroid_mir[i XOR 4] . B_mir = P_yz(centroid_fwd[i]) . P_yz(B) = centroid_fwd[i] . B  (dot product invariant under orthogonal transform) => softmax weights equal => K_fwd[i] == K_mir[i XOR 4]  QED
partition_kernel: apply_gamma_312 (inherits Fix1 extents payload + Fix2 uniform Sector A split)
G_inject_rule: identical to EXP-311/312 (alpha_leak, beta_CA, mass_ref, kappa_ref unchanged)
fork_a_assertions: K_child sum = K_budget * N * exp(-LAMBDA_DECAY) within 1e-10
fork_b_assertions: K_fwd[i] == K_mir[i XOR 4] for all i in {0..7} (budget covariance, delta < 1e-10)
forbidden: ghost_direct_control | stalk_collapse | retroactive_confluence_cert | budget_retroactive_adjustment | validity_predicate_shift | post_hoc_rewrite_rule_addition
K_budget_root_note: K_budget_root = N * K_budget_312 = 8 * 256 = 2048. When beta_Z=0: K_child_i = 2048*(1/N)*exp(-0.1) = 256*exp(-0.1) -- recovers EXP-312 individual child budgets exactly.
convergence_proof: K_child_i = K_budget * w_i * exp(-LAMBDA_DECAY) < K_budget * exp(-LAMBDA_DECAY) < K_budget (since w_i <= 1 and exp(-LAMBDA_DECAY) < 1). Budget strictly decreases every level.
divergence_note: Prior formula K_budget*N*w_i*exp(-LAMBDA_DECAY) diverges when N*w_max*exp(-LAMBDA_DECAY)>1 (for B=[1,0.5,0.3], beta_Z=2.0, N=8: 8*0.24*0.905=1.74>1). Corrected by removing N factor.
